# WashroomNearMe

> Public washrooms in Indian cities, organised by facility type and amenity — with a source on every facility.

## What this site covers
- 10 cities: Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Pune.
- Filter by facility type (mall, metro, airport, hospital, office, fuel station) and by amenity (baby changing, women-only, family room, wheelchair, attendant).

## Pages
- / — hub and city list
- /{city}/ — facilities in a city, with map
- /{city}/{facet}/ — only where the city has 3 or more such facilities
- /washroom-near-me/ · /about/ · /methodology/ · /privacy/

## Data policy
Amenities, access and hours are published only when sourced. Unverified values render as "not recorded".
